description: This file implements a graphics library loader within the gfxstream namespace, providing functions to load shared libraries dynamically and retrieve function symbols from them. It includes a class `Lib` with methods for loading libraries and fetching symbols, and a nested class `LibraryCloser` for managing resource cleanup.

classes.name: Lib
classes.description: A class responsible for loading shared libraries and retrieving symbol addresses.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a shared library specified by name and returns an expected object wrapping the Lib instance or an error string.

methods.name: GetSymbol
methods.description: Retrieves a function pointer from the loaded library by symbol name.

nested_classes.name: Lib::LibraryCloser
nested_classes.description: A functor for closing a loaded library using dlclose.

methods.name: LibraryCloser::operator()
methods.description: Closes the library if the pointer is not null.

methods.name: gfxstream::expected<Lib,std::string> Load(const char * name)
methods.description: Loads a shared library and returns an expected result.

methods.name: Lib::FunctionPtr GetSymbol(const char * name)
methods.description: Returns a symbol from the loaded library.
